title: Optimize Segmentation Pipeline with Class Imbalance
description: A multi-class semantic segmentation model is stuck at IoU=0.18 due to severe class imbalance (background dominates 85% of pixels). You must switch the loss function and add a LR scheduler to reach IoU≥0.55 within 5 epochs.

initial_state.architecture_summary: U-Net: Encoder(EfficientNet-B3) -> BottleNeck(512) -> Decoder(4x UpConv + SkipConnections) -> Conv2d(32, num_classes=8). Loss: CrossEntropyLoss (unweighted). LR: 0.0005 (constant). Class distribution: background=85%, road=5%, building=4%, vegetation=3%, vehicle=1.5%, person=0.8%, sky=0.5%, other=0.2%.
training_logs: WARNING: Class imbalance detected. Background class dominates predictions. mIoU plateau at 0.18. Target: 0.55 in 5 more epochs.

dice_loss_only.message: ✅ Dice loss applied. Handles class imbalance much better than CrossEntropy. IoU jumping but needs LR scheduling to converge fully.
training_logs: Dice loss dramatically improving minority class predictions. Need scheduler.

focal_loss_only.message: ✅ Focal loss applied with gamma=2.0. Better focus on hard-to-classify pixels. IoU improving. Add a scheduler to push further.
training_logs: Focal loss reducing easy-negative dominance. Scheduler needed for convergence.

cosine_scheduler_only.message: ⚠️ CosineAnnealing LR scheduler added. Small improvement but CrossEntropy can't handle the class imbalance. Switch loss function.
training_logs: Scheduler alone insufficient. Background still dominates predictions.

dice_and_cosine.message: 🏆 Perfect! Dice loss + CosineAnnealingLR conquered the class imbalance. mIoU=0.58 ≥ 0.55!
training_logs: 🎉 Target reached! mIoU=0.58 ≥ 0.55. All 8 classes now well-segmented.

focal_and_cosine.message: 🏆 Excellent! Focal loss + CosineAnnealingLR achieved the target. mIoU=0.56 ≥ 0.55!
training_logs: 🎉 Target reached! mIoU=0.56 ≥ 0.55. Focal loss handled rare classes well.

dice_and_step_scheduler.message: ⚠️ Dice loss + StepLR got to IoU=0.46 — improved but StepLR's abrupt decay doesn't suit this task. Try CosineAnnealingLR.
training_logs: Epoch 8  | train_loss=0.5012 | val_loss=0.5812 | mIoU=0.40  LR step decay
Under target. StepLR decay too aggressive for convergence.

crossentropy_and_scheduler.message: ⚠️ CrossEntropy + scheduler can't overcome the class imbalance. Background class dominates. Switch to Dice or Focal loss.
training_logs: Plateau at 0.34. CrossEntropy fundamentally limited for imbalanced segmentation.

modify_hyperparameters.message: ⚠️ Tuning LR/batch size alone won't fix class imbalance. The loss function needs to change.
training_logs: Marginal change. Class imbalance is the core issue.

add_dropout.message: ⚠️ Dropout is not the issue. The problem is class imbalance in the loss function.
training_logs: Dropout added noise. No benefit for this problem.

add_data_augmentation.message: ⚠️ Augmentation helps slightly with generalization but doesn't address the core loss function issue.
training_logs: Slight improvement from aug. Still need better loss for class imbalance.

default.message: ⚠️ Unknown action. For class-imbalanced segmentation: use change_loss_function (Dice or Focal) AND add_lr_scheduler (cosine).
training_logs: No meaningful change. IoU still at 0.18.
